entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Be careful with what you decide to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be careful with what you decide to do, Mrs. Morgna."
entries.menuText: "Be careful with what you decide to do, Mrs. Morgna."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Jump to: [Reformist Branch Start]

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I can't believe you are supporting..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe you are supporting this too."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""While I respect her, I doubt that..."
entries.dialogueText: "While I respect her, I doubt that she's capable of creating major obstacles for us. But we have to keep close eyes on her."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's true. We have bigger fish t..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's true. We have bigger fish to catch."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""She's not our main problem here.""
entries.dialogueText: "She's not our main problem here."
entries.menuText: "She's not our main problem here."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Oh she will. I don't think she has..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh she will. I don't think she has that in her."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will make sure she stays in line.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will make sure she stays in line."
entries.menuText: "I will make sure she stays in line."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, keep an eye on her. We can't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, keep an eye on her. We can't let her sabotage us."
entries.menuText: "Yes, keep an eye on her. We can't let her sabotage us."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We already know that the Old Guard..."
entries.dialogueText: "We already know that the Old Guards will block any reforms to the Constitution. So, they would definitely want to work with you to preserve it, if that's still what you want to do."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I... Don't get me wrong. I am with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I... Don't get me wrong. I am with you. I was only saying that you could go over the draft. I didn't notice if that came out wrong."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Maybe we can first go over the dra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe we can first go over the draft of the amendments that the committee prepared for reforms. You do not have to approve it."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Let's not go that far, Mrs. Morgna..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not go that far, Mrs. Morgna. I'm sure we can figure something out. If Mr. President can get Orso Hawker to work with him..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Fine. Let's hear it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. Let's hear it."
entries.menuText: "Fine. Let's hear it."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's troublesome.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's troublesome."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've heard the security reports. N..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard the security reports. Now is not the time for reform."
entries.menuText: "I've heard the security reports. Now is not the time for reform."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I just do not trust the Chief Just..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just do not trust the Chief Justice in delivering any promises. I'm afraid that ignoring the demands for reform might create some future problems for our administration."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She left the room and slammed the d..."
entries.dialogueText: She left the room and slammed the door behind her.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So what do you suggest we do?""
entries.dialogueText: "So what do you suggest we do?"
entries.menuText: "So what do you suggest we do?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: BaseGame.Relations_Nia_Opposition = true

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I think we can figure something ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think we can figure something out. You can call a meeting with Orso Hawker. We are not here to destroy the legacy of Tarquin Soll. Why not work with them?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You too?""
entries.dialogueText: "You too?"
entries.menuText: "You too?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I understand, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave a fake smile and left the..."
entries.dialogueText: She gave a fake smile and left the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave a fake smile."
entries.dialogueText: She gave a fake smile.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""With all due respect, Mr. Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, Mr. President. You are being gullible in thinking you can survive by leaning against the remnants of Soll's autocracy."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Work with the reformists on writin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Work with the reformists on writing a more democratic Constitution for Sordland. Change cannot be stopped."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How about you, Petr?""
entries.dialogueText: "How about you, Petr?"
entries.menuText: "How about you, Petr?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She didn't respond."
entries.dialogueText: She didn't respond.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good day to you too, Mrs. Morgna.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good day to you too, Mrs. Morgna."
entries.menuText: "Good day to you too, Mrs. Morgna."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will be watching you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will be watching you."
entries.menuText: "I will be watching you."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course, sir. Let's proceed to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, sir. Let's proceed to the draft."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Have a good day.""
entries.dialogueText: "Have a good day."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Come now, I can't have you all go..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come now, I can't have you all go against me on this."
entries.menuText: "Come now, I can't have you all go against me on this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me in shock. She had..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me in shock. She had no words to say.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I appreciate your thoughts. Now le..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your thoughts. Now let's move on."
entries.menuText: "I appreciate your thoughts. Now let's move on."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""With all due respect, I will take..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, I will take my leave from this meeting. I don't think I have anything to add anymore, and I won't sit here and listen to plans of tyranny."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""You cannot stop change from happen..."
entries.dialogueText: "You cannot stop change from happening, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Even though I do not trust the Chi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even though I do not trust the Chief Justice, I think we can set up a meeting with him to discuss working together to handle the opposition."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She grabbed her notes and went towa..."
entries.dialogueText: She grabbed her notes and went towards the door.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So you came here to tell me not to..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you came here to tell me not to do this."
entries.menuText: "So you came here to tell me not to do this."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I do not. I have already explained..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not. I have already explained Mr. President my position on working with the Old Guards."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia stood up with rage."
entries.dialogueText: Nia stood up with rage.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: BackToAutocrat

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I can't believe this!""
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe this!"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I'm sorry you feel that way, Mr. P..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry you feel that way, Mr. President. But I thought you picked me because you wanted to bring justice to Sordland."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Blocking the way of the reforms wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Blocking the way of the reforms will create many enemies for us. Our best bet would definitely be working with the Old Guards..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""YES. I thought I already explained..."
entries.dialogueText: "YES. I thought I already explained myself."
entries.menuText: "YES. I thought I already explained myself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I am disappointed in you, Mrs. Mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am disappointed in you, Mrs. Morgna."
entries.menuText: "I am disappointed in you, Mrs. Morgna."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No, let's try to work with the ref..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, let's try to work with the reformists on a new Constitution."
entries.menuText: "No, let's try to work with the reformists on a new Constitution."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Watch your words, Mrs. Morgna.""
entries.dialogueText: "Watch your words, Mrs. Morgna."
entries.menuText: "Watch your words, Mrs. Morgna."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, sir."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""With all due respect, I have to sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, I have to say that I feel disappointed. I thought this administration was going to bring real change. It seems Sollism still lives on."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Excuse me gentlemen. The reforms a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excuse me gentlemen. The reforms are not just *some* problem, they are absolutely necessary to democratize this country."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Okay. Let's see what these suggest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Okay. Let's see what these suggested reforms are."
entries.menuText: "Okay. Let's see what these suggested reforms are."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Look, I will not reform the Consti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look, I will not reform the Constitution. We have other problems."
entries.menuText: "Look, I will not reform the Constitution. We have other problems."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""So we're officially against the co..."
entries.dialogueText: "So we're officially against the constitutional reforms?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Looks like it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Looks like it."
entries.menuText: "Looks like it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sollism will never die.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sollism will never die."
entries.menuText: "Sollism will never die."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not *officially.*""
entries.dialogueText: "Not *officially.*"
entries.menuText: "Not *officially.*"
